content: MkDocs strict mode (mkdocs build --strict or strict: true in mkdocs.yml) converts all warnings to errors and exits non-zero. Markdown-exec does NOT trigger a build failure on its own when a Python exec block raises an exception; instead it renders the traceback in place and the build continues. The pyfda project already has scripts/check_docs_figures.py that post-build scans the site/ HTML for Traceback and class=exec-error markers, exiting non-zero if found. This custom script is the right approach since --strict alone does not catch exec block failures. CI should run: mkdocs build --strict followed by python scripts/check_docs_figures.py site/.
